title: Body authoring: all JSON, lint/fixtures and conflicting immutable definitions
head: b6678ea9ba4a7cf0313ce83e0c0fc6b0e5c26d5b

reviews.classification: Full authoring proposal with concrete cross-owner template identity and instance-binding findings
reviews.disposition:
F1. Complete read covers all1182 input lines: the complete four JSON envelopes BA-E1–E4, twelve BA-C checks, seventeen BA-L diagnostics, fourteen BA-F fixture groups, six BA-G phases, all eighteen pack routes, BA1–BA12 and BA-S1–S5. Templates, numerical profiles, mutable instances, starts, origins and foe settlement remain different records. Capacity1 is neither mastery1 nor one meter. A template's function or named policy string needs an actual resolver/consumer; parseable JSON and allowlisted metadata are not implementation. All four examples are separately presented envelopes with the same village.bodies/revision1 header; combine selected definitions into one reviewed manifest or give independent pack identities rather than registering four colliding packs.

F2. The seven JSON blocks across this file and START_SPECS parse, but their hound definitions conflict under the same village.bodies.hound revision1 reference. SS-A adds read and carry.mouth and changes functions, defeat, intake, rest and lifespan fields. These are useful explicit start refinements, not compatible unchanged template bytes. Before executable adoption, select one consolidated immutable definition or allocate a distinct reviewed revision/variant and pin its actual hash. Preserve both authored drafts as history. Comparison identities/results are saved in authoring-definition-comparison-b244.json; parsing/comparison proves draft shape and difference, not compiler acceptance, old-save migration or gameplay.

F3. BA-E3's immutable extension contains the concrete village.bodies.practice_blade.sample_object reference while the text correctly assigns particular custody/body-item identity to an instance. Treat that sample as unresolved instance binding: a shipping definition must declare a supported binding token/initializer or put the actual stock-unit reference in the instance, then prove each admitted copy has its own unique body/item identity. The four sample body/life/instance IDs also need real origin allocation. A shared template can serve player, companion and foe without sharing mutable wounds, XP, custody or stock; foe XP/pelt chance stays outside the template and actual player attacks do not pay self loot.

F4. Wolf's source stats can remain strong while mind, senses, stamina, nutrition and social access are explicitly authored. A native attack_speed value mapped to cadencePerSecond needs actual unit/adapter verification rather than assuming matching names. Extract reviewed JSON constants rather than instantiate the singleton Enemy/import its global callbacks. Sapling's produce.reed_sap vocabulary explicitly names a separately authored product; it grants neither reedling stock nor recipe substitution. Blade rest.mode none does not imply free repair, and a surviving hilt retains only channels the actual damage/source allows. Actual innate perfection, free source repair, renewable parts and powerful parallel means remain possible under AD22/AD38 rather than being banned by ordinary examples.

F5. Keep lint findings scoped: a .weapon access is not a reproduced bug, legitimate form admission needs its own reviewed exception, and AST/static closure cannot prove all commit/completion bypasses absent. Missing canon evidence, source restrictions and executable means are different diagnostics. Proposed sixteen-attempt/eight-module generation budgets and fixture matrices are not universal species limits or measured throughput. Pure preview/retained resolved results protect selected history; rejection/fallback occurs before accepted-life commitment rather than regenerating anatomy on import. Complete-envelope precommit failures differ from postdurable publication repair, which cannot refund committed progress. Preserve consequential identity/custody/receipts when compressing history under ACR.

F6. The old milestone,1366-primary viewport, proposal to leave all absent bodies absent and body-only enrollment/migration suggestions require their actual selected compatibility/current authority; do not impose contradictory global policies from separate drafts. Current campaign order, desktop prose-first context, AD36/AD43 stages, AD42 optional review and AD51 selected-consumer reuse govern executable work. Under AD32 no schema3 registry, lint tool, generator, fixture module, content directory or new body is adopted by this review. Historical source/dossier locators, negative test searches and all native/browser/save proof keep their dates. No runtime or source acquisition occurred.
reviews.evidence: All1182 input lines delivered in ranges1–150,151–340,341–540,541–750,751–960,961–1100,1101–1182. Four authoring plus three previously reviewed start-spec JSON blocks parsed/compared without compiler/runtime execution; exact identities in saved comparison artifact.
reviews.reopen: Before selecting executable content, reconcile same-ref differing hound definitions, pack header collisions and blade instance binding. Allocate actual schema/version/consumer and relevant migration proof without activating unrelated whole-body work.

folds.heading: ## Authoring-template conflict folded into start selection (B244, 2026-11-04)
folds.body:
F1. The complete BA authoring read exposes a draft identity conflict relevant to SS-A: both documents use village.bodies.hound revision1, but this start template adds read/carry.mouth and differs in five top-level fields (functions, defeat, intake, rest, lifespan). The seven example JSON blocks parse; that does not make the two definitions interchangeable or executable. Before selecting this start for implementation, consolidate one immutable template or allocate a reviewed revision/variant, and freeze the resulting manifest/hash with the origin. Preserve the original proposals rather than silently pretending one revision always meant both definitions. Exact pre-fold inputs and comparison are in the task's authoring-definition-comparison-b244.json.

F2. BA's separately shown village.bodies/revision1 example envelopes also need a consolidated manifest or distinct pack identity before registration, and the sample blade stock-unit reference needs actual instance binding. These are authoring/compatibility findings, not current runtime defects or permission to launch a body compiler. This supplement retains the earlier SS-C appointment inconsistency and all qualified source/admission gaps. Under AD32 this remains documentation reconciliation; AD36/AD43 govern any later selected implementation.
